description: Vertical / topic → theme color mapping. The orchestrator agent reads this when picking the `theme:` frontmatter value for a generated landing. Each key is a normalized topic slug; each value is one of the eight theme names declared in 00-tokens/tokens.css ([data-theme="…"]).
notes: Pick the closest semantic match — the list is intentionally short. If the topic is not here, fall back to the `default` theme.
Themes are colour families, NOT industries. Adding a new vertical does NOT require adding a new theme — pick the closest existing one.
The orchestrator should set `theme: <name>` in landing.spec.json. The preview renderer emits the matching `<body data-theme="<name>">` wrapper.
